purpose: Apply the frozen V28 signal formula to isolated .V31 symbols without changing any signal decision rule.
parity_partition_rule: Use the original frozen 2025 and pre-August-2026 dataset boundaries independently so December 2025 is excluded exactly as in V28 evidence.
external_replication_interval_rule: The external 2018-2024 interval is one continuous dataset; only a cohort whose natural next-rebalance exit is before 2025-01-01 is eligible.
